commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a reading of 42 and the deterministic gate registering WEAK, disciplined execution mandates capital preservation. Stan Weinstein emphasized that poor breadth creates treacherous headwinds for Stage 2 breakouts, while William O'Neil noted that three out of four equities inevitably succumb to broader index distribution. While the Nifty consolidates within 23,250–23,450 with low volatility (VIX 12.14), a WEAK gate environment requires progressive exposure: reduce initial position sizing, demand accelerating quarterly earnings, and enforce strict stop discipline. In this tape, technically setting up candidates devoid of confirmed CANSLIM earnings power must be capped at Watch or Avoid, preserving fire-power strictly for verified fundamental leaders.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Darvas Box Disciplines

20MICRONS.technical: Constructing a Stage 2 breakout from a double-bottom base at 233.76, backed by strong 2.58× volume. Price holds firmly above rising 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA, exhibiting textbook Vibha Jha 3-up sequence off moving averages.
20MICRONS.fundamental: Specialty minerals business generates a 17.3% ROCE with low leverage (D/E 0.35). However, flat-to-contracting revenue (-0.99% YoY) and sluggish 5.3% EPS growth fail CANSLIM's 25% hurdle, indicating muted near-term operational acceleration.
20MICRONS.risk: A break below the 214.7 stop violates neckline support and the 50-DMA, aborting the double-bottom pivot thesis.

3MINDIA.technical: Tight consolidation within 1.5% of its 37,337.3 pivot above advancing 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA. RSI at 63 shows unextended upside momentum, though 1.19× volume indicates only mild institutional accumulation.
3MINDIA.fundamental: High-quality multinational franchise with zero debt, pristine balance sheet, and superior 50% ROCE. While top-line expansion remains robust at +19% YoY, net profit flattened (-0.4% YoY) due to margin pressures, stalling CANSLIM earnings momentum.
3MINDIA.risk: Violation of the 35,593.73 stop invalidates the pivot structure, forcing an immediate defensive exit under Minervini rules.

63MOONS.technical: Clearing double-bottom resistance near 958.91 with RSI at 71 and MACD positive above the zero line. Price trades comfortably above all key moving averages, but overhead supply from historical peaks remains a major barrier.
63MOONS.fundamental: Topline exploded +350% YoY to ₹137 Cr, but the business remains structurally unprofitable with a ₹47.6 Cr quarterly net loss and negative ROCE (-3.7%). Unresolved legal and NSEL contingencies present unacceptable fundamental risk.
63MOONS.risk: Close beneath the 873.2 stop level signals pattern breakdown, invalidating the breakout attempt.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Coiling near the 103.60 breakout level above its 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA with positive MACD confirmation. However, the consolidation lacks high-volume pocket pivots, signaling retail-dominated rather than institutional participation.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Fundamentals severely lag chart action. Revenue collapsed -56.3% YoY and net profit dropped 25.6% to just ₹1.02 Cr, yielding an anemic 5.6% ROCE and sub-2.5% net margin. Completely misses CANSLIM quality filters.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Breach of the 94.71 stop violates base support; cut immediately to protect capital.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Classic Stage 2 double-bottom breakout clearing the 933.53 neckline on a massive 4.75× volume spike. Strong bullish engulfing candle confirms genuine institutional demand; moving averages are aligned in textbook Minervini Trend Template fashion.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Turnaround thesis playing out via Atali facility commercialization and high-margin CDMO contract ramp-up. Q1 net profit surged 53.8% YoY on 38.7% sales growth, reversing prior quarterly contractions with modest 0.35 D/E and 10.7% ROCE.
AARTIPHARM.risk: A drop below 860.84 penetrates the double-bottom base low, forcing immediate stop discipline.

ABDL.technical: Coiling tightly within 1.5% of its 712.41 pivot above rising 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA. RSI at 67 shows steady upward momentum, but volume remains average, awaiting institutional commitment.
ABDL.fundamental: Spirits leader benefits from premiumization with an 18.4% ROCE, yet Q1 PAT declined 13% YoY alongside muted 6.1% sales growth. An elevated 82× P/E requires accelerating bottom-line expansion, which is currently absent.
ABDL.risk: A break below the 673.47 stop violates moving average support, triggering strict loss-cutting.
